<section class="page" id="library">
 <h1>About our library</h1>
 <p class="lead">The Information Resource Centre of WP/Ke/President’s College provides a wide range of information resources capable of supporting readers’ reading, learning, creativity, and knowledge development. The school library consists of a collection of over 6,300 books, enabling both students and teachers to access a wide range of information.</p>
 <div class="grid" style="margin-top:20px">
  <div class="card"><h3>Colour-coded shelves</h3><p>Book shelves are arranged according to a colour-coding system, so all users can reach information quickly and easily.</p></div>
  <div class="card"><h3>Books for teachers</h3><p>A dedicated collection of books is available in the library for the aesthetic appreciation of teachers.</p></div>
  <div class="card"><h3>Mobile library for parents</h3><p>A mobile library has been initiated so that parents can read too.</p></div>
  <div class="card"><h3>Mobile book boxes</h3><p>A mobile book box system is maintained for the relief periods.</p></div>
  <div class="card"><h3>Games and puzzles</h3><p>Chess, puzzle-solving, Rubik’s cubes and scrabble kits attract students to the library and make it an enjoyable place of intellectual value.</p></div>
  <div class="card"><h3>A resource centre</h3><p>In addition to books, the library holds magazines, newspapers, periodicals and learning equipment.</p></div>
 </div>
</section>

 <h1>Reading activities</h1>
 <p class="lead">Reading becomes a habit when it is shared. Join any of these programmes.</p>

 <div class="grid">

  <div class="card"><h3>Reading challenge</h3><p>Read 20 books in a school year and earn a library certificate.</p><span class="tag">Grades 6–11</span></div>
  <div class="card"><h3>Book club</h3><p>A weekly lunchtime discussion of a short story, novel chapter or poem.</p><span class="tag">Grades 9–13</span></div>
  <div class="card"><h3>Story hour</h3><p>Prefects read aloud to younger classes in the picture-book corner.</p><span class="tag">Grades 1–5</span></div>
  <div class="card"><h3>Read-aloud contest</h3><p>Prepare a two-minute passage and perform it for the house judges.</p><span class="tag">Inter-house</span></div>
  <div class="card"><h3>Library week</h3><p>Quizzes, a book fair, a book swap and a meet-the-author session.</p><span class="tag">Yearly</span></div>
 </div>

<section class="page" id="authors">
 <h1>Author life</h1>
 <p class="lead">Behind every book is a person. Meet four writers who shaped Sinhala literature.</p>
<article class="au"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Portrait of Martin Wickramasinghe" loading="lazy"><div><h3>Martin Wickramasinghe</h3><div class="yr">May 29, 1890 – July 23, 1976</div><p>Martin Wickramasinghe is widely celebrated as the father of modern Sinhala literature. Born in Koggala, Sri Lanka, he was largely self-educated after leaving school at sixteen, eventually rising to prominence as an influential journalist and editor for major newspapers such as Dinamina and Silumina before becoming the nation’s foremost novelist, short story writer, and literary critic.</p><p>Renowned for pioneering literary realism in Sinhala fiction, Wickramasinghe vividly captured the social, cultural, and economic transformations of twentieth-century rural Sri Lanka. His masterpieces, most notably Madol Doova (1947), Viragaya (1956), and his acclaimed trilogy Gamperaliya (1944), Kaliyugaya (1957), and Yuganthaya (1949), have been translated into several languages and adapted into landmark films. Today, his legacy is preserved at his ancestral home in Koggala, which operates as the Martin Wickramasinghe Folk Museum.</p></div></article>
<article class="au"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Portrait of Kumaratunga Munidasa" loading="lazy"><div><h3>Kumaratunga Munidasa</h3><div class="yr">July 25, 1887 – March 2, 1944</div><p>Kumaratunga Munidasa was a celebrated Sri Lankan writer, poet, grammarian, journalist, and language reformer. Born in Dikwella in southern Sri Lanka, he dedicated his life to revitalizing and preserving the purity of the Sinhala language, most notably by founding the Hela Havula movement, which advocated for the use of pure indigenous Sinhala vocabulary free from Sanskrit and Pali borrowings.</p><p>A prolific scholar and educator, Munidasa transformed Sinhala children’s literature and grammar while editing influential publications such as Lak Mini Pahana and Subasa. His beloved children’s classics, including Hath Pana, Magul Kama, and Heensaraya, along with foundational grammatical works like Vyakarana Vivaranaya, remain cornerstones of Sri Lankan education and literature today.</p></div></article>
<article class="au"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Portrait of K. Jayatilaka" loading="lazy"><div><h3>K. Jayatilaka</h3><div class="yr">June 27, 1926 – September 14, 2011</div><p>Kaluachchigamage Jayatilaka was an eminent Sri Lankan novelist, short story writer, literary critic, and publisher. Born in Kannimahara in the Gampaha District, he emerged as one of the foremost voices of modern Sinhala realistic fiction, portraying the subtle psychological struggles, moral dilemmas, and social realities of rural and middle-class Sri Lankan life with restraint and authenticity. A multi-time State Literary Award winner, Jayatilaka authored acclaimed novels such as Charitha Thunak (1963), Aprajithayo (1965), Adhishtana (1967), and Pithamaha (1966), alongside influential works of literary criticism and children’s literature.</p><p>Beyond his own writing, he made a lasting contribution to Sri Lankan publishing by founding Pradeepa Publishers, helping nurture and distribute quality Sinhala literature to generations of readers.</p></div></article>
<article class="au"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Portrait of Sybil Wettasinghe" loading="lazy"><div><h3>Sybil Wettasinghe</h3><div class="yr">October 31, 1927 – July 1, 2020</div><p>Affectionately known across Sri Lanka as “Sybil Nanda,” Sybil Wettasinghe was an iconic children’s book author, illustrator, and journalist. Raised in the southern village of Gintota, she began her career as a newspaper illustrator at Lankadeepa and Janata before publishing her breakthrough story, Kuda Hora (The Umbrella Thief), in 1956, which went on to gain international acclaim and was translated into several languages, including Japanese, English, and Chinese.</p><p>Over a career spanning more than six decades, Wettasinghe wrote and illustrated over 200 beloved children’s books, such as Vesak Kooduwa, Meti Gedara Lamai, and Sooththara Puncha, characterized by whimsical folkloric artwork, gentle humor, and vivid depictions of rural Sri Lankan childhood. Her pioneering work earned numerous national and international honors, including the State Literary Award and Japan’s prestigious Nikkei Asia Prize for Culture.</p></div></article>
</section>

<section class="page" id="creative">
 <h1>Creative activities</h1>
 <p class="lead">We turn what students read into something they make: sketches, paintings and posters displayed in the library.</p>
 <div class="ph3"><figure><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Pencil sketch of a peacock feather and a flute" loading="lazy"><figcaption>Pencil sketch of a peacock feather and flute, shown on the library display wall.</figcaption></figure><figure><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Students’ posters about their favourite authors" loading="lazy"><figcaption>“My favourite author” posters made by students about the authors they admire.</figcaption></figure><figure><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Painting of a ballerina silhouette under a starry sky" loading="lazy"><figcaption>Canvas painting of a ballerina under the stars, by a Grade 6 student.</figcaption></figure><figure><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Poster with traditional paintings and a portrait" loading="lazy"><figcaption>Poster on Sinhala art and literature, with paintings and an elder’s portrait.</figcaption></figure><figure><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Painting of a red and green parrot on a branch" loading="lazy"><figcaption>Acrylic painting of a parrot by a Grade 9 student.</figcaption></figure><figure><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Pencil sketch of a tree beside a winding river" loading="lazy"><figcaption>Pencil landscape sketch of a tree, a winding river and birds.</figcaption></figure></div>
 <div class="grid">
  <div class="card"><h3>Art exhibitions</h3><p>Students’ paintings and sketches are hung and displayed for the whole school to enjoy.</p></div>
  <div class="card"><h3>My favourite author</h3><p>Students research an author, then design a poster with a portrait, book covers and their own thoughts.</p></div>
  <div class="card"><h3>Sketching and painting</h3><p>Pencil, watercolour and acrylic work inspired by nature, stories and poems.</p></div>

<section class="page" id="news">

 <p class="lead">Events, programmes and reports from President’s College Library.</p>

 <span class="badge">Library news</span>
 <h1 lang="si" style="margin-top:10px">ජාතික කියවීම් මාසයට සමගාමීව පාසල් පුස්තකාල සතිය සහ පාසල් පුස්තකාල දිනයට අදාළව පැවැත්වූ වැඩසටහන් සමාලෝචනය – 2026</h1>
 <div class="cov"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Report cover collage"><div>
  <p class="lead">During National Reading Month 2026, WP/KE President’s College Library held School Library Week (October 26 – 30) with competitions, exhibitions, a magazine launch and a literary festival.</p>
  <h3 lang="si">හැඳින්වීම</h3>
  <p class="si" lang="si">සාහිත්‍ය මාසයට සමගාමීව පාසල් පුස්තකාලය මගින් සිසුන් සහ ගුරුභවතුන්ගේ කියවීමේ රුචිය, නිර්මාණශීලීත්වය සහ සාහිත්‍ය පිළිබඳ අවබෝධය වර්ධනය කිරීමේ අරමුණින් විවිධ නිර්මාණාත්මක තරග සහ වැඩසටහන් සංවිධානය කරන ලදී. මෙමගින් සිසුන් සහ ගුරුභවතුන් තුළ පොත්පත් කියවීමේ උනන්දුව ඇති කිරීම මෙන්ම කියවූ දෑ ඇසුරින් ස්වකීය අදහස් හා නිර්මාණශීලී හැකියාවන් ප්‍රකාශ කිරීමට අවස්ථාව උදා කිරීම අපේක්ෂා කරන ලදී.</p>
 </div></div>

 <h2 lang="si">පටුන · Programmes</h2>
 <div class="cov"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="School Library Week poster"><ol class="si" lang="si">
  <li>සාහිත්‍ය මාසයට සමගාමීව පුස්තකාලය මගින් පවත්වනු ලැබූ විවිධ තරග</li><li>හොඳම පාඨකයා තේරීම</li><li>පොත් පිංචක් නිර්මාණය කිරීම</li><li>“ප්‍රියතම කතුවරයා” නිර්මාණ පුවරුවක් සකස් කිරීම</li><li>ලබා දුන් ග්‍රන්ථ ඇසුරින් විචාරයක් ලිවීම</li><li>කාසි, නෝට්ටු සහ මුද්දර ප්‍රදර්ශනය</li><li>චිත්‍ර ප්‍රදර්ශනය</li><li>සිංහල සාහිත්‍ය උළෙල හා සුභාෂාභිමානි සඟරාව එළි දැක්වීම</li><li>ගුරුභවතුන් සඳහා කාව්‍ය නිර්මාණ එළි දැක්වීම</li></ol></div>

 <h2 lang="si">1. සාහිත්‍ය මාසයට සමගාමීව පුස්තකාලය මගින් පැවැත්වූ තරග</h2>
 <h3 lang="si">6 / 7 ශ්‍රේණි සිසුන් සඳහා</h3>
 <p class="si" lang="si">අඹ යාළුවෝ, හත්පන, වන ගත ළමයි, හඳපාන, කුඩා හොරා, හපනා යන ග්‍රන්ථ පිළිබඳ තොරතුරු ඇතුළත් පොත් පිංචක් නිර්මාණාත්මකව සකස් කිරීම. කතුවරයාගේ නම, ග්‍රන්ථයේ නම, ඔහුගේ වෙනත් කෘති සහ සිත් ගත් චරිතය ඇතුළත් කළ යුතු විය.</p>
 <div class="gal"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Student booklets 1" loading="lazy"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Student booklets 2" loading="lazy"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Student booklets 3" loading="lazy"></div>
 <h3 lang="si">8 ශ්‍රේණි සිසුන් සඳහා</h3>
 <p class="si" lang="si">ලබා දී ඇති කතුවරුන් අතරින් කැමති කතුවරයකු තෝරාගෙන “මගේ ප්‍රියතම කතුවරයා” නිර්මාණ පුවරුවක් A3 කොලයක් භාවිතා කර සකස් කිරීම. (ටී.බී. ඉලංගරත්න, සිබිල් වෙත්ත සිංහ, කුමාරතුංග මුනිදාස, මාර්ටින් වික්‍රමසිංහ, කේ. ජයතිලක)</p>
 <div class="gal"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="My favourite author posters 1" loading="lazy"></div>
 <h3 lang="si">9 / 10 ශ්‍රේණි සිසුන් සඳහා</h3>
 <p class="si" lang="si">මැයි මාර ප්‍රසංගය, ගම් පෙරළිය, අඹ යහළුවෝ යන ග්‍රන්ථ වලින් එක් ග්‍රන්ථයක් පිළිබඳ වචන 250ට නොඅඩු විචාරයක් ලිවීම.</p>
 <div class="gal"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Book reviews 1" loading="lazy"></div>

 <h2 lang="si">2. හොඳම පාඨකයා තේරීම</h2>
 <p class="si" lang="si">සෑම වර්ෂයකම මෙන්ම 2026 වර්ෂයේද ජනාධිපති විද්‍යාලීය හොඳම පාඨකයා තරඟ තේරීම් කමිටුවේ නිර්ණායකයන්ට අනුව තෝරා ගන්නා ලදී.</p>

 <h2 lang="si">3. පැරණි කාසි, නෝට්ටු හා මුද්දර ප්‍රදර්ශනය</h2>
 <p class="si" lang="si">පාසල් පුස්තකාල පරිශ්‍රයේදී පැවති පැරණි කාසි, නෝට්ටු හා මුද්දර ප්‍රදර්ශනයේ ඡායාරූප කිහිපයකි.</p>

 <h2 lang="si">4. “චමත්කාර” චිත්‍ර ප්‍රදර්ශනය</h2>
 <p class="si" lang="si">සිසුන් “චමත්කාර” චිත්‍ර ප්‍රදර්ශනයට සූදානම් වෙමින්, සහ පාසල් ප්‍රධාන ශාලාවේ පැවති ප්‍රදර්ශනයේ සොඳුරු මතකයන්.</p>

 <h2 lang="si">5. “සුභාෂාභිමානි” සාහිත්‍ය සඟරාව එළි දැක්වීම</h2>
 <p class="si" lang="si">කියවීමේ මාසයට සමගාමීව පවත්වන ලද සිංහල සාහිත්‍ය උළෙලේදී “සුභාෂාභිමානි” සාහිත්‍ය සඟරාවේ පළමු කලාපය එළි දැක්විණි.</p>

 <h2 lang="si">වැඩසටහන් සමාලෝචනය</h2>
 <p class="si" lang="si">බප/කැල ජනාධිපති විද්‍යාලයේ පුස්තකාලය මූලික කර ගනිමින් පවත්වනු ලැබූ මෙම තරග සිසුන් අතර කියවීමේ රුචිය වර්ධනය කිරීමටත් සාහිත්‍ය නැඹුරුව වර්ධනය කිරීමටත් අරමුණු කර ගන්නා ලදී. පුස්තකාලය නිතර භාවිතා කරන, වැඩිම ග්‍රන්ථ ප්‍රමාණයක් කියවා ඇති සිසුන් ඇගයීමට අවස්ථාවක් ලැබුණු අතර, කාසි, නෝට්ටු හා මුද්දර ප්‍රදර්ශනයෙන් ඓතිහාසික, කලාත්මක මෙන්ම අධ්‍යාපනික වටිනාකම් දරුවන්ට දැක බලා ගැනීමට හැකි විය.</p>
 <p class="si" lang="si">“චමත්කාර” චිත්‍ර ප්‍රදර්ශනය සිසු දරුවන්ගේ හා ආචාර්ය මණ්ඩලයේ කලාත්මක කුසලතා, නිර්මාණශීලීත්වය හා පරිකල්පන ශක්තිය එළිදැක්වීමට මහඟු පිටුබලයක් විය. “සුභාෂාභිමානි” සාහිත්‍ය සඟරාව ප්‍රථමවරට එළි දැක්වීමෙන් සිසුන්ට පමණක් නොව ගුරුභවතුන්ටද තම සාහිත්‍ය හා කාව්‍යමය කුසලතා ප්‍රදර්ශනය කිරීමට අවස්ථාව ලැබිණි.</p>
 <p class="si" lang="si">මෙම සියලු කර්තව්‍යයන්හි ඉදිරියේ සිට මග පෙන්වූ බප/කැල ජනාධිපති විද්‍යාලයේ ගරු විදුහල්පති, නියෝජ්‍ය විදුහල්පතිවරුන් ඇතුළු ආචාර්ය මණ්ඩලය සහ අනධ්‍යයන කාර්ය මණ්ඩලය කෘතඥතාවෙන් සිහිපත් කරමු.</p>
 <p style="color:var(--mute)">— Library, WP/KE President’s College</p>
</section>

<script>
const $=s=>document.querySelector(s),$$=s=>[...document.querySelectorAll(s)];
const esc=s=>String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;'}[c]));
const today=()=>new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);
const addDays=(d,n)=>{const x=new Date(d);x.setDate(x.getDate()+n);return x.toISOString().slice(0,10)};
const seed={books:[
["B001","Gamperaliya","Martin Wickramasinghe","Sinhala fiction"],["B002","The English Patient","Michael Ondaatje","Fiction"],["B003","Running in the Family","Michael Ondaatje","Memoir"],["B004","2001: A Space Odyssey","Arthur C. Clarke","Science fiction"],["B005","Rendezvous with Rama","Arthur C. Clarke","Science fiction"],["B006","Gitanjali","Rabindranath Tagore","Poetry"],["B007","Harry Potter and the Philosopher’s Stone","J. K. Rowling","Fantasy"],["B008","The Diary of a Young Girl","Anne Frank","Biography"],["B009","Madol Doova","Martin Wickramasinghe","Sinhala fiction"],["B010","A Brief History of Time","Stephen Hawking","Science"],["B011","Atlas of the World","Reference desk","Reference"],["B012","The Little Prince","Antoine de Saint-Exupéry","Children"]
].map(b=>({id:b[0],title:b[1],author:b[2],cat:b[3],loan:null})),
members:[{id:"M001",name:"Nimali Perera",cls:"Grade 10A"},{id:"M002",name:"Kasun Fernando",cls:"Grade 8C"},{id:"M003",name:"Ms. Silva",cls:"Teacher"}]};
let db=null;
try{db=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("pcl-db"))}catch(e){}
if(!db||!db.books)db=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(seed));
const save=()=>{try{localStorage.setItem("pcl-db",JSON.stringify(db))}catch(e){}};
const mem=id=>db.members.find(m=>m.id===id);
const held=id=>db.books.filter(b=>b.loan&&b.loan.m===id).length;
const limit=m=>/teacher/i.test(m.cls)?5:3;
function toast(t){const e=$("#toast");e.textContent=t;e.style.display="block";clearTimeout(toast.t);toast.t=setTimeout(()=>e.style.display="none",2600)}

const pages=["home","library","reading","authors","creative","news","report-2026","catalog","about"];
function route(){let h=location.hash.slice(1);if(!pages.includes(h))h="home";
 $$(".page").forEach(p=>p.classList.toggle("on",p.id===h));
 $$("#nav a").forEach(a=>a.classList.toggle("on",a.dataset.p===(h==="report-2026"?"news":h)));
 render();window.scrollTo(0,0)}
addEventListener("hashchange",route);

$("#vf").onchange=e=>{const f=e.target.files[0];if(!f)return;const v=$("#vid");v.src=URL.createObjectURL(f);v.hidden=false;$("#ph").hidden=true;v.play().catch(()=>{})};

const BASE={books:6300,loan:2350,over:0,members:2136};
function stats(){const out=BASE.loan+db.books.filter(b=>b.loan).length,od=BASE.over+db.books.filter(b=>b.loan&&b.loan.due<today()).length,tb=BASE.books+db.books.length-seed.books.length,tm=BASE.members+db.members.length-seed.members.length;
 return [["Books",tb.toLocaleString()],["Available",(tb-out).toLocaleString()],["On loan",out.toLocaleString()],["Overdue",od],["Members",tm.toLocaleString()]].map(s=>`<div class="stat"><b>${s[1]}</b>${s[0]}</div>`).join("")}
function render(){
 $("#hstats").innerHTML=stats();$("#cstats").innerHTML=stats();
 $("#newb").innerHTML=db.books.slice(-4).reverse().map(b=>`<div class="card"><h3>${esc(b.title)}</h3><p>${esc(b.author)}</p><span class="tag">${esc(b.cat)}</span></div>`).join("");
 const q=$("#q").value.toLowerCase(),f=$("#fs").value;
 $("#bb").innerHTML=db.books.filter(b=>(!q||(b.title+b.author+b.cat).toLowerCase().includes(q))&&(!f||(f==="out")===!!b.loan)).map(b=>`<tr><td>${b.id}</td><td>${esc(b.title)}</td><td>${esc(b.author)}</td><td>${esc(b.cat)}</td><td class="st ${b.loan?"out":"in"}">${b.loan?"Issued":"Available"}</td><td>${b.loan?`<button class="btn sm o" data-ret="${b.id}">Return</button>`:`<button class="btn sm" data-iss="${b.id}">Issue</button>`} <button class="btn sm o" data-del="${b.id}" aria-label="Delete ${esc(b.title)}">Delete</button></td></tr>`).join("")||`<tr><td colspan="6">No books match. Try a different search.</td></tr>`;
 $("#mb").innerHTML=db.members.map(m=>`<tr><td>${m.id}</td><td>${esc(m.name)}</td><td>${esc(m.cls)}</td><td>${held(m.id)} of ${limit(m)}</td></tr>`).join("");
 const ls=db.books.filter(b=>b.loan);
 $("#lb").innerHTML=ls.map(b=>{const m=mem(b.loan.m),od=b.loan.due<today();return`<tr><td>${esc(b.title)}</td><td>${esc(m?m.name:"Unknown")}</td><td>${b.loan.date}</td><td class="${od?"st out":""}">${b.loan.due}${od?" (overdue)":""}</td><td><button class="btn sm" data-ret="${b.id}">Return</button></td></tr>`}).join("");
 $("#lempty").hidden=ls.length>0;
}
$("#q").oninput=render;$("#fs").onchange=render;
$$(".tabs button").forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{$$(".tabs button").forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle("on",x===b));["books","members","loans"].forEach(t=>$("#t-"+t).hidden=t!==b.dataset.t)});

let onOk=null;
function ask(title,html,ok,fn){$("#dt").textContent=title;$("#dbody").innerHTML=html;$("#dok").textContent=ok;onOk=fn;$("#dlg").showModal()}
$("#dc").onclick=()=>$("#dlg").close();
$("#df").onsubmit=e=>{e.preventDefault();if(onOk&&onOk()!==false)$("#dlg").close()};
const nid=(p,a)=>p+String(Math.max(0,...a.map(x=>+x.id.slice(1)))+1).padStart(3,"0");

$("#addb").onclick=()=>ask("Add book",`<label for="f1">Title</label><input id="f1"><label for="f2">Author</label><input id="f2"><label for="f3">Category</label><input id="f3">`,"Add book",()=>{
 const t=$("#f1").value.trim(),a=$("#f2").value.trim(),c=$("#f3").value.trim();if(!t||!a||!c){toast("Fill in title, author and category.");return false}
 db.books.push({id:nid("B",db.books),title:t,author:a,cat:c,loan:null});save();render();toast("Book added")});
$("#addm").onclick=()=>ask("Add member",`<label for="f1">Name</label><input id="f1"><label for="f2">Class or role</label><input id="f2" placeholder="e.g. Grade 9B or Teacher">`,"Add member",()=>{
 const n=$("#f1").value.trim(),c=$("#f2").value.trim();if(!n||!c){toast("Fill in name and class.");return false}
 db.members.push({id:nid("M",db.members),name:n,cls:c});save();render();toast("Member added")});

document.addEventListener("click",e=>{const t=e.target;
 if(t.dataset.iss){const b=db.books.find(x=>x.id===t.dataset.iss);
  ask("Issue “"+b.title+"”",`<label for="f1">Member</label><select id="f1">${db.members.map(m=>`<option value="${m.id}">${esc(m.name)} (${esc(m.cls)})</option>`).join("")}</select><p>Due in 14 days for students, 30 days for teachers.</p>`,"Issue book",()=>{
   const m=mem($("#f1").value);if(held(m.id)>=limit(m)){toast(m.name+" has reached the limit of "+limit(m)+" books.");return false}
   b.loan={m:m.id,date:today(),due:addDays(today(),limit(m)===5?30:14)};save();render();toast("Issued to "+m.name)})}
 if(t.dataset.ret){const b=db.books.find(x=>x.id===t.dataset.ret);b.loan=null;save();render();toast("Book returned")}
 if(t.dataset.del){const b=db.books.find(x=>x.id===t.dataset.del);if(b.loan){toast("Return the book before deleting it.");return}
  ask("Delete book",`<p>Delete “${esc(b.title)}” from the catalogue?</p>`,"Delete",()=>{db.books=db.books.filter(x=>x!==b);save();render();toast("Book deleted")})}
});
route();
